note: Canonical assembled-revision BODY (Memo 079, PRD-16 answerable questions + Slice-2b Research register; Memo 080, PRD-R1 head table + six mandatory prose sections + snag/goal/maintenance sections; Memo 080, PRD-R2 the VISIBLE generation note + the scope line in the head). SINGLE SOURCE for the cross-repo byte-parity gate: RevisionAssembler (core) freezes it and DoltDbAssembler (viewer) must reproduce it byte-for-byte. The questions-json fence carries the FULL answerable canonical shape (title/hintergrund/frage/aiRecommendation/typ/options[]); the ## Research section renders the memo-local research + research_topics + research_files edges; the head renders the generation note, the scope line (one figure per content carrier — never revision/provenance/history_journal, which are written after the render), the five mandatory `| **Feld** | Wert |` rows, and the six prose sections come from the memo_section carrier. Regenerate by re-seeding the canonical rows through the production writers (RevisionAssembler.test seedCanonical / DoltDbAssembler.test seedFullCanonical) and re-hashing full-body.md into both repo copies. sha256 is over full-body.md; a one-sided renderer edit fails its repo parity test (render !== fixture / hash). Memo 080, PRD-R1 Vollausbau: the head now carries SEVEN `| **Feld** | Wert |` rows (the five mandatory ones plus the document level's Typ + Aenderungen), the section sequence is the DECLARED document order (BlockSections.documentSections, REV-18 Z. 158-172) with the eight collective sections in a declared tail (Memo 080, PRD-F1 added the CONDITIONAL `## Zurueckgestellte Fragen` as the eighth — it renders only on a retired stock), every block carries its toolkit body from the block_section carrier in REGISTER order (absent mandatory/generated headings with the explicit empty mark), and `## Kontaminations-Metadaten` renders from the sessions table. Memo 080, PRD-R2 Vollausbau: the head note is GERMAN and names source, producer and check (`memo-<NNN>.db` / `memo revision assemble` / `memo revision parity`), and the scope line carries the NINE figures of the Umfangszeile in the seven groups of the SHARED template test/fixtures/revision-scope-line-v1.json — a figure whose carrier is absent renders `nicht ausweisbar`, never 0. The seed therefore also fills block_chapter, prd and topic.status, which are NOT rendered anywhere else: without them both renderers would only agree on a row of zeros. Memo 080, PRD-F1: `## Beantwortete Fragen` is split by answer provenance into the two `### ` subsections the file parser reads (only a non-empty group is written), the questions-json fence carries the six lifecycle fields (status/statusReason/replacedBy/answeredBy/answeredInRev/note) beside the boolean `answered` so a re-projection cannot clobber the lifecycle, and the conditional `## Zurueckgestellte Fragen` section renders the retired stock — absent here, because this seed has none. Memo 080, PRD-P3: `## Lessons-Learned` now carries TWO statements — the frozen prose of the revision AND the appending Lessons table under it (lesson_learned + lesson_source). The seed writes ONE lesson with TWO provenance rows, the second naming a FOREIGN memo on purpose, so the fixture really renders the QUALIFIED reference join (`M076/WI-109 · M079/REV-01:42`) instead of agreeing on an empty mark; an empty table renders `_keine Lessons-Learned_`, which is a different statement from the prose mark `_kein Inhalt_`. Memo 082, M082-09-08 (WI-122): every answered block carries the `- **Entscheidungsweg:**` line directly below `User-Entscheidung` — NOT optional, because a line that appears only sometimes cannot be told apart from a missing one. F2 renders the freely chosen state, F3 the `nicht erhoben` state of a record whose provenance was never taken; a block that predates the `preselected` column is never reported as an independent decision.
